resolution.finding: C0 garden/bicycle low PSNR is a PROTOCOL ARTIFACT of C0's 1920x1080 non-uniform stretch, NOT a C0 H8_MR renderer weakness. Under the SAME stretch, Faster-GS drops equally (garden -5.56 dB, bicycle -7.70 dB vs aspect-preserve) and over-densifies (4.8M gaussians).
resolution.consequence: The earlier 'Faster-GS 8.4 dB stronger than C0 on garden' was an apples-to-oranges protocol comparison (FGS aspect-preserve vs C0 stretch). Under the same protocol the comparison is MIXED (C0 wins room+bicycle, FGS wins garden) — NOT a significant/consistent Faster-GS advantage.
resolution.caveat: SSIM metric differs (C0 SepSSIM vs FGS DSSIM); SSIM values not directly comparable. PSNR/LPIPS comparable. Garden C0 is single-seed (s42).

CORRECTION_2026-09-30.what_was_wrong: Prior 'same-protocol' comparison used C0 numbers computed on the ALL-camera-trained P12_C0 checkpoint evaluated on every-8th cameras (metrics_common + c0_unseen_eval.py). Those every-8th cameras were IN C0 training, so they are TRAIN-VIEW subset numbers, NOT unseen-view. Comparing them to Faster-GS's true held-out (-s test) was apples-to-oranges.
CORRECTION_2026-09-30.root_cause: The 'train-test gap ~ 0' observation compared two subsets that were BOTH in training (all-cams vs every-8th); it is trivial and says nothing about generalization. The real generalization gap (true-holdout vs train-view) is 1.36/2.60/4.72 dB.
CORRECTION_2026-09-30.fix: Built publication_trainer_p12_holdout8.py (derived from pinned publication_trainer_p12.py; 3-line change) that EXCLUDES every-8th camera from C0 training and evaluates on them = true unseen-view. Verified zero leakage via camera_sequence.npy.

corrected_unseen_view_comparison.protocol: 1920x1080 non-uniform stretch (== C0 GTDataset 1080p), 30K iters, seed42, black bg, 0.8*L1+0.2*(1-SSIM) fused, TRUE holdout: every-8th camera excluded from TRAINING on BOTH sides, evaluated on the same physical held-out cameras (C0 cameras.json img_name order == FGS sorted filename order).
corrected_unseen_view_comparison.conclusion: Faster-GS is stronger on ALL THREE scenes under a valid true-unseen-view iso-protocol; decisive on bicycle (+3.04 dB). C0's H8_MR renderer overfits more (generalization gap grows 1.36->2.60->4.72 dB with scene complexity). Faster-GS also trains faster (396/651/579s vs C0 516/816/869s).
corrected_unseen_view_comparison.evidence_class: OBSERVED (full 30K true-holdout C0 train+eval on EPIC-05 A100, zero leakage verified; FGS stretch -s test eval logs)
